scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:infra && pnpm run dev:migrate && pnpm run dev:store
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d platform-db store-db store-redis traefik api admin && pnpm run dev:wait-db
scripts.dev:wait-db: until docker exec econome-store-db pg_isready -U postgres -d medusa-v2 > /dev/null 2>&1 && docker exec econome-platform-db pg_isready -U platform -d platform > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done
scripts.dev:migrate: pnpm --filter api run db:push && pnpm --filter store run medusa:migrate && pnpm run dev:seed
scripts.dev:seed: pnpm --filter store run seed && (pnpm --filter store exec medusa user -e admin@admin.com -p admin123 || true)
scripts.dev:local: pnpm run dev:infra:local && pnpm run dev:migrate && turbo run dev
scripts.dev:infra:local: docker compose up -d platform-db store-db store-redis traefik && pnpm run dev:wait-db
scripts.dev:docker: docker compose up -d && pnpm run dev:migrate
